game_updates.title: update2.7.0
game_updates.contents: ・New official map "Egypt" has been added. ・When playing on random maps, you can now toggle ON/OFF whether to include each map in the lottery. Collaboration maps are set to OFF by default. ・Added random elements to the official map "Penguin Hotel". ・Fixed an issue where players could get stuck too deeply into walls on the official map "HIKAKIN Museum".

Auto-Generate RoofsAs Dahuang introduces more and more gameplay mechanics, excessive building micro-management has become a burden.Plus, building roofs has always been a bit cumbersome, so we've made them generate automatically.This will also make it easier for us to create new roof styles for noble mansions in the future.After building a room, a roof will be automatically generated for that room.After demolishing a room, its corresponding roof will disappear.At the bottom of the room interface, there will be an "Enable Roof" option. Unchecking this option is equivalent to not building a roof, which should cause some facilities underneath to lose durability due to being exposed.When hovering the mouse over a roof, a transparent effect will be applied, which also works for thatched sheds.Th...

game_updates.title: Hotfix Live for Version 3.29.1!
game_updates.contents: Fixed an issue where if player backed out to the title screen, they wouldn't get progress in Resplendent Rivals until rerolling a challenge or restarting the game. Fixed an issue where players with 120 or higher FPS monitors might experience FPS stutter in-game. Fixed art overflow on the Full Card Model. Fixes verticalization of text on the Simple card model under Chinese and Japanese. Fixed a crash that might happen during game start. Fixed a crash that might happen when selecting field.

game_updates.contents: The Palworld 1.0 update sure is a big one, and with all of the new pals, weapons, and zones to track it's easy to miss the little things—like new resources for crafting. As I climbed the revamped tech tree again, I breezed through most recipes until I ran into hardwood. It's a new tier of the basic building block you'll see pop up in later level recipes (around 40 to 50), after planks... Read more.

game_updates.title: The Infinite Museion and Update 1.6 Community Survey

game_updates.title: An Update from the Anti Cheat Team - Auto Aim Manipulation
game_updates.contents: Effective immediately, the use of “jitter aim” and/or RC filters to exploit aim assist systems and negate recoil on controllers is unequivocally considered cheating. We are taking a firm stance against players using these cheats and are taking action to stop them.Apex Legends is now equipped with the necessary in-game detections to identify and disable these exploits. Players who are caught attempting to use hardware or software to alter aim assist or recoil patterns will be flagged as cheaters and have their accounts banned in accordance with our TOS.We are implementing this crackdown at a crucial time, to support fair play at EWC Paris, in addition to maintaining competitive integrity across Apex Legends. While we are implementing this solution to combat the issue, we have alternate anti...

game_updates.title: Palworld PSA: you might want to uninstall your mods if you've not played in a while ahead of its 1.0 launch
game_updates.contents: Well, would you look at that. Palworld is launching into 1.0 tomorrow! Somehow an entire two years and then some passed to get to this point, but here we almost are, several updates and a notable lawsuit later. For some of you it might have been a while since you booted the game up, so its developer Pocketpair have a word of warning for you: be careful about those mods you've got installed. Read more

game_updates.title: X4: Foundations Player Feedback Survey 2026
game_updates.contents: Greetings,Feedback from our players has always been a guiding light for our work on the X Universe. We are constantly discussing reviews, forum posts, and comments internally, and your feedback during our open betas is invaluable as we strive to make each update the best it can be.In an effort to better understand our players and align our priorities, we’ve created a survey to learn more about your experiences, playstyles, preferences, and desires.We estimate this survey will take roughly 10 minutes to complete, and we encourage you to skip questions if you don’t have a particular opinion on the subject.We sincerely thank you for taking the time to share your thoughts with us and for helping shape the future of X4: Foundations.TAKE THE SURVEY

game_updates.title: Palworld won't raise its price for 1.0 as 'a small way of saying thank you'
game_updates.contents: We're just a day away from Palworld's much anticipated 1.0 release, and to celebrate Pocketpair both released all 27 pages of patch notes and confirmed that there'll be no price hike when the survival and crafting game exits from early access. Oh yeah, it's all coming together... Read more.

game_updates.title: Subnautica 2 celebrates 5 million copies sold ahead of Adaptive Measures, its first early access update
game_updates.contents: It comes as a surprise to absolutely no one that Subnautica 2 has finally surpassed 5 million copies sold. It did sell two million copies in just 12 hours after all. Then, not that long ago, it broke 4 million copies sold, which was excellent for everyone involved except for Krafton. And now its 5 million copies sold coincides with its first major update in early access, 1.1... Read more.

game_updates.title: Small Beta Hotfix 0.8.090
game_updates.contents: Few quick wordsFor those who worry, even if technical issues are distracting us, we are constantly working on new content and features. It's just things aren't ready to be published yet. And if our comittment to some bugs seems baffling to you, please also remember that the game has a relatively large audience which makes even quite obscure bugs ruin people's playthroughs on daily basis, in other words if it wasn't important, we wouldn't prioritize it.I wish, more than anyone, that progress on content was quicker, but we're doing everything we can, and I truly think that the team can't grow any larger without introducing risk. Finally, if I ever make a vote on Twitter or Discord about some potential refactor, I think some people assume this is our main concern at the moment and nothing get...
